'''Accelerator shields''' were a class of shield used on the [[garbage pit]]s of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. There were 5,000 such pits spread across the planet, each of which was covered by four convex accelerator shields. The shields were perforated with hundreds of holes, each 10 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in diameter, through which garbage was periodically fired into space.<ref name="CatCW" />
